summary: Specific read-only task candidates for PR #491 (Antigravity Bridge stricter mock/receipt treatment and continuity)

candidates.title: Disqualify unverified EXECUTE_INSTRUCTION mock receipts from emitting PASS
candidates.defect_addressed: scripts/run_antigravity_bridge.py:298-308 emits verdict=PASS for generic instruction without executing commands or asserting tests
acceptance_criteria: Generic instructions without test commands or mutations must emit verdict='UNVERIFIED' or 'SIMULATION'
Chief review router must refuse AUTO_APPROVE_SAFE_RESULT for UNVERIFIED/SIMULATION and stop at HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED
Deterministic test suite confirms rejection of fake green

candidates.title: Validate all 9 lifecycle fields in Antigravity Bridge RESULT envelopes
candidates.defect_addressed: Ensure bridge envelopes comply with integration_contract.validate_durable_result and preserve workkey, owner, status, input_fingerprint, source_sha, action, test_result, result_id, next_action
acceptance_criteria: AntigravityHookRunner.on_task_completion projects and binds all 9 canonical lifecycle fields
Result files validate against courier_core/schemas/antigravity_result.schema.json and integration contract
Zero field loss across subprocess / restart boundary

candidates.title: Verify task claim and release continuity under bridge crash and stop hooks
candidates.defect_addressed: Prevent orphaned claims or lingering locks when bridge stops or fails unexpectedly
acceptance_criteria: on_task_failure marks task quarantined/BLOCKED with cause without dropping exclusion lock prematurely
No double-claim concurrency possible on bridge task resumption
